theme.en: AI Compute Scales as Access Rules Tighten
theme.zh: AI算力扩张，远程访问管制收紧

dek.en: The U.S. extends advanced-chip controls to cover how overseas data centers serve remote customers. At SC26, a 10,000-plus-GPU optical network and a live demo that splits inference across two kinds of chips show how operators are building capacity.
dek.zh: 美国扩大先进芯片出口管制，将境外数据中心向客户提供远程算力的方式纳入监管。SC26上，一套连接逾万颗GPU的光互连网络和一场由两类芯片分担推理任务的现场演示，展示了算力基础设施扩容的不同路径。

title.en: Policy & Export Controls
title.zh: 政策与出口管制

title.en: U.S. Targets Remote Access to Advanced AI Chips
title.zh: 美国将先进AI芯片的远程访问纳入管制

summary.en: The U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security issued an interim final rule targeting access to advanced AI chips and servers via data centers outside China and other arms-embargoed markets. The measure adds licensing requirements for certain advanced computing shipments and transfers involving Brazil, Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand. Chip vendors and cloud operators now have to consider who will use the compute alongside where the hardware will be installed.
summary.zh: 美国商务部工业与安全局发布临时最终规则，针对中国等受武器禁运国家和地区通过境外数据中心远程使用先进AI芯片和服务器的情形。规则对涉及巴西、印度尼西亚、马来西亚、新加坡和泰国的部分先进计算产品出口、再出口和境内转移新增许可要求。芯片供应商和云服务商在评估合规时，需要同时考虑设备部署地点和算力的实际使用者。

title.en: Singapore Reviews Impact of U.S. Chip Controls
title.zh: 新加坡评估美国芯片管制的影响

summary.en: Singapore's trade and digital ministries said they are assessing the new U.S. controls with affected companies and discussing implementation with U.S. officials. Their talks include how eligible Singapore companies can retain access to advanced chips, an issue for local cloud operators planning GPU deployments.
summary.zh: 新加坡能源与贸易工业部和数码发展及新闻部表示，正与受影响企业评估美国新规，并与美方沟通实施细节。双方讨论的议题包括如何让符合条件的新加坡企业继续获得先进芯片，这关系到当地云服务商接下来的GPU部署。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Lambda Deploys Co-Packaged Optics for More Than 10,000 GPUs
title.zh: Lambda部署共封装光学网络，连接逾万颗GPU

summary.en: Lambda and Nvidia disclosed a production network at Lambda's Quebec campus connecting more than 10,000 Blackwell Ultra GPUs with switches that use co-packaged optics. The deployment brings optical engines into the switch package at cluster scale, where network power and link reliability affect how much GPU capacity customers can use.
summary.zh: Lambda与英伟达披露，Lambda在魁北克园区已投产一套采用共封装光学（CPO）交换机的网络，连接逾1万颗Blackwell Ultra GPU。此次部署在万卡集群中把光引擎集成到交换芯片封装内，网络功耗和链路可靠性会直接影响客户可用的算力。

title.en: Nvidia Unveils Rubin HPC GPU for 2028
title.zh: 英伟达发布Rubin HPC GPU，预计2028年供货

summary.en: Nvidia unveiled Rubin HPC at SC26 and expects the scientific-computing GPU to be available in 2028. The company specifies more than 50,000 CUDA cores per GPU, acceleration for sparse data operations and seventh-generation NVLink. The design targets workloads such as simulations, where getting irregularly accessed data to the cores can limit performance.
summary.zh: 英伟达在SC26发布面向科学计算的Rubin HPC GPU，预计于2028年供货。据公司披露，单颗GPU配有逾5万个CUDA核心，支持稀疏数据操作加速和第七代NVLink互连。该设计面向仿真等工作负载，这类任务往往会因数据访问不规则、计算核心等待数据而受限。

title.en: AMD-Powered Lux Debuts at No. 14 on TOP500
title.zh: 搭载AMD芯片的Lux首次登上TOP500，位列第14

summary.en: Oak Ridge National Laboratory's Lux system debuted at No. 14 on the November TOP500, using EPYC CPUs and more than 4,000 Instinct MI355X GPUs. Lux is the first of two systems under a $1 billion U.S. Department of Energy and AMD partnership. AMD hardware powers 202 systems on the full list, up from 177 a year earlier.
summary.zh: 橡树岭国家实验室的Lux首次登上11月TOP500榜单，位列第14，采用EPYC CPU和逾4,000颗Instinct MI355X GPU。Lux是美国能源部与AMD总额10亿美元合作项目中的首套系统，该项目共建设两套系统。整份榜单中，采用AMD硬件的系统从一年前的177套升至202套。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: TSMC Shares Drop 9.7% in Three Sessions After Record Sales
title.zh: 台积电月营收创新高，美股ADR随后三日跌9.7%

summary.en: TSMC's U.S.-listed shares fell 9.7% over three sessions through Monday after the foundry reported record October revenue of NT$586.89 billion, up 59.7% from a year earlier. The selloff came amid wider concerns about AI infrastructure financing, leaving investors to weigh that uncertainty against the foundry's recent sales growth.
summary.zh: 台积电此前公布10月营收达到创纪录的新台币5,868.9亿元，同比增长59.7%。截至周一，其美国存托凭证在三个交易日内下跌9.7%。这一轮下跌反映出，尽管台积电近期销售强劲，市场仍在评估AI基础设施融资能否支撑客户今后的采购。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: SK hynix’s Sales to Top Customer Double to Nearly 35 Trillion Won
title.zh: SK海力士来自最大客户的营收翻番，接近35万亿韩元

summary.en: SK hynix disclosed 34.98 trillion won in January–September sales to its largest customer, widely believed to be Nvidia, up from 17.36 trillion won a year earlier. Analysts linked the increase to higher HBM4 shipments after the memory entered full-scale production in the third quarter. The customer accounted for 14.79% of sales over the nine months, compared with 26.98% for all of 2025.
summary.zh: SK海力士披露，今年前九个月对最大客户的销售额为34.98万亿韩元，上年同期为17.36万亿韩元，业内普遍认为该客户是英伟达。分析人士认为，增长得益于HBM4在第三季度进入大规模量产后出货增加。该客户占SK海力士今年前九个月营收的14.79%，2025年全年的这一比例为26.98%。

title.en: Equipment & Advanced Packaging
title.zh: 设备与先进封装

title.en: SemiFive Unveils 3D Packaging That Stacks DRAM on Logic
title.zh: SemiFive推出将DRAM堆叠在逻辑芯片上的3D封装平台

summary.en: SemiFive unveiled an SC26 packaging platform that stacks DRAM directly above logic and uses hundreds of thousands of connections between the dies. The company says shorter signal paths can lower energy per bit, while eliminating the interposer could reduce packaging costs. The platform gives custom AI chip designers a way to pursue high memory bandwidth with a different package layout from standard HBM.
summary.zh: SemiFive在SC26发布一款3D封装平台，将DRAM直接堆叠在逻辑芯片上方，两者之间设置数十万条物理互连通道。公司称，缩短信号传输距离有望降低每比特能耗，省去中介层则有望降低封装成本。这为定制AI芯片提供了一条实现高内存带宽的路径。

title.en: Earnings & Outlook
title.zh: 业绩与展望

title.en: Tower Looks to Silicon Photonics to Lift Margins
title.zh: Tower寄望硅光业务带动利润率上升

summary.en: Tower Semiconductor's outlook calls for about $600 million in fourth-quarter revenue and roughly $2 billion for 2026, following third-quarter sales of $526 million, up 33% year over year. Tower is targeting a $1.1 billion annualized silicon photonics revenue run rate in the fourth quarter. How quickly the company brings on new capacity will help determine whether it can reach its 2028 targets of $3.6 billion in revenue and $1.2 billion in net profit.
summary.zh: Tower Semiconductor预计第四季度营收约6亿美元，2026年全年约20亿美元。第三季度营收为5.26亿美元，同比增长33%。公司预计第四季度硅光业务的年化营收规模可达11亿美元，新产能的投产速度将影响其能否实现2028年36亿美元营收和12亿美元净利润的目标。

title.en: Accelerator Challengers
title.zh: 加速器新势力

title.en: Intel and SambaNova Demo Inference Split Across Two Chips
title.zh: 英特尔与SambaNova展示两类芯片分工推理

summary.en: Intel and SambaNova demonstrated a disaggregated inference system at SC26 that uses Intel D270 GPUs for prompt prefill and SambaNova SN50 reconfigurable dataflow units for token generation. Both systems use air cooling. Splitting the stages lets operators provision prefill and decode capacity separately, which can help them accommodate changes in the mix of prompt and output lengths.
summary.zh: 英特尔与SambaNova在SC26展示了分离式推理架构，由英特尔D270 GPU负责提示词预填充，SambaNova SN50可重构数据流单元负责解码并生成词元。两套设备均采用风冷。拆分推理阶段后，运营商可以分别配置预填充和解码的算力，以适应输入和输出长度分布的变化。

theme.en: Data Movement Shapes Hardware and Inference
theme.zh: 数据搬运影响硬件与推理性能

dek.en: An FPGA prototype measures the cost of loading model weights, while systems papers test how to move inference data across GPU memory, host DRAM and SSDs. Other papers cover amorphous materials design, sub-terahertz receivers and quantum-circuit trainability.
dek.zh: 一项FPGA实验测量了加载模型权重的开销，多篇系统论文则研究如何在GPU显存、主机DRAM和SSD之间搬运推理数据。本期也收录了非晶材料设计、亚太赫兹接收机和量子线路可训练性的研究。

title.en: Devices & Materials
title.zh: 器件与材料

title.en: Graph Diffusion for Inverse Design of Disordered Materials
title.zh: 用图扩散模型逆向设计无序材料

papers.authors: Jiani Hu, Chenyan Wang, Yongkun Yang, et al.

summary.en: GaDiT generates disordered atomic structures using dynamic periodic graphs and diffusion conditioned on target properties. In tests on amorphous carbon, silicon and silica, the authors report sampling roughly 100 times faster than existing corrector-based methods. The model can propose structures with combinations of properties outside the training distribution, which could expand the search space for amorphous electronic materials.
summary.zh: GaDiT将动态周期图与按目标属性设定条件的扩散模型结合，用于生成无序原子结构。在非晶碳、非晶硅和非晶二氧化硅的测试中，作者报告采样速度约为现有基于校正步骤的方法的100倍。模型还可提出属性组合超出训练分布的候选结构，有助于扩大非晶电子材料的搜索范围。

title.en: Circuits & Architecture
title.zh: 电路与架构

title.en: Two-Round Estimation for Sub-Terahertz OFDM Receivers
title.zh: 面向亚太赫兹OFDM接收机的两轮估计

summary.en: PACT jointly estimates the channel and oscillator phase noise in sub-terahertz OFDM, then uses the decoder's confidence and provisional symbol decisions to refine both estimates. At an Eb/N0 of 30 dB, its code-block error rate was about 70% and 57% lower than the best learning-based baseline across two benchmark settings, respectively. The results show how decoder feedback can improve reception when fading and oscillator noise act together.
summary.zh: PACT在亚太赫兹OFDM接收机中联合估计信道和振荡器相位噪声，再利用译码置信度和初步符号判决细化两项估计。在Eb/N0为30 dB时，两组基准测试的码块错误率分别比表现最好的学习型基线低约70%和57%。结果表明，当信道衰落与振荡器相位噪声同时存在时，译码反馈有助于改善接收性能。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Interconnects
title.zh: AI加速器与互连

title.en: Agilex FPGA Measures the Cost of Gated DeltaNet State Paging
title.zh: Agilex FPGA实测Gated DeltaNet状态分页开销

summary.en: The authors implemented one layer of a 369-million-parameter Gated DeltaNet hybrid on an Agilex 5 FPGA and paged its recurrent state to external memory. With synthetic weights at 75 MHz, the layer took 11.15 ms per token, with weight matrix-vector operations accounting for about 62% of the time and state handling including paging for 13%. For this implementation, optimizing weight delivery has more scope to improve latency than optimizing state paging.
summary.zh: 作者在Agilex 5 FPGA上实现了一个3.69亿参数Gated DeltaNet混合模型中的一层，并将循环状态分页存入片外内存。使用合成权重、在75 MHz下实测，该层每个词元耗时11.15毫秒，其中权重矩阵与向量相乘约占62%，包含分页在内的状态处理占13%。在这套实现中，优化权重供给比优化状态分页更有望缩短延迟。

title.en: Obaleth Compiles GPU-Initiated Communication with Compute
title.zh: Obaleth联合编译GPU主动发起的通信与计算

papers.authors: Javid Baydamirli, Ismayil Ismayilov, Kaan Oktay, Didem Unat

summary.en: Obaleth brings GPU-initiated communication into a kernel's intermediate representation so the compiler can schedule transfers alongside computation. In an all-to-all test on 256 H100 GPUs with 256 bytes per peer, it ran 1.25× as fast as NVSHMEM and 2.3× as fast as NCCL GIN. On 16 B200 GPUs serving Qwen3-235B in vLLM, it cut time per output token by 10–24% compared with DeepEP.
summary.zh: Obaleth将GPU主动发起的通信纳入内核的中间表示，使编译器可以统一调度数据传输和计算。在256颗H100上进行每个对端256字节的全对全通信测试时，其速度分别为NVSHMEM的1.25倍、NCCL GIN的2.3倍。在16颗B200上用vLLM部署Qwen3-235B时，相较于使用DeepEP，每个输出词元的耗时缩短了10%至24%。

title.en: AI Research & Inference Systems
title.zh: AI研究与推理系统

title.en: MosaicKV Schedules KV-Cache Pages Across Cloud Tenants
title.zh: MosaicKV为多租户云推理调度KV缓存页

summary.en: MosaicKV treats KV-cache pages as a shared resource that can move between GPU HBM and host DRAM as workloads compete for memory. It uses the decoder's predictable layer order to prefetch pages and schedule microbatches around PCIe transfers. This gives a cloud operator a way to manage tail latency for time to first token when tenants collectively need more cache capacity than the GPU provides.
summary.zh: MosaicKV将KV缓存页视为多个租户共享的资源，根据显存竞争情况在GPU的HBM与主机DRAM之间迁移。系统利用解码器逐层访问顺序可预测的特点进行预取，并按PCIe传输进度安排微批次。在租户的缓存总需求超过GPU显存容量时，这种调度可用于控制首词元延迟的长尾。

title.en: JetFire Uses Hybrid Memory for Long-Context Attention
title.zh: JetFire利用分层内存计算长上下文注意力

papers.authors: Feng Yu, Hongshi Tan, Yao Chen, Gustavo Alonso, Weng-Fai Wong, Bingsheng He
papers.affiliation: National University of Singapore, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, ETH Zürich

summary.en: JetFire scans a quantized KV-cache copy in GPU HBM to identify the tokens that contribute most to attention, then uses full-precision data in host DRAM to correct their contributions. At the longest context lengths shared by both systems, JetFire-K3V2 ran end to end 1.3–3.0× as fast as TurboQuant in vLLM. The split lets the system store a compact copy of the full context on the GPU and use high precision selectively.
summary.zh: JetFire先扫描GPU HBM中的量化KV缓存副本，找出对注意力贡献最大的词元，再利用主机DRAM中的全精度数据修正这些词元的贡献。在两种方法均支持的最长上下文条件下，JetFire-K3V2在vLLM中的端到端速度为TurboQuant的1.3至3.0倍。这种分工让GPU只需保留完整上下文的低精度副本，并将高精度计算集中在关键位置。

title.en: Octopus Retrieves Sparse KV Cache Across Multiple SSDs
title.zh: Octopus用多块SSD并行读取稀疏KV缓存

papers.authors: Tuowei Wang, Liyun Chu, Ruwen Fan, Ju Ren

summary.en: Octopus uses correlations in sparse attention to identify groups of KV-cache entries that are frequently fetched together. It distributes those groups across SSDs in advance and selectively replicates them so reads can be spread across drives. The design addresses the I/O bottleneck of using flash as a lower-cost capacity tier for persistent inference caches.
summary.zh: Octopus利用稀疏注意力中的访问相关性，找出经常被一同读取的KV缓存条目。系统预先将这些条目组分布到多块SSD，并有选择地复制部分条目组，使读取负载可以在多块盘之间分摊。该设计针对把闪存用作持久化推理缓存的低成本容量层时遇到的I/O瓶颈。

title.en: Quantum Computing
title.zh: 量子计算

title.en: Circuit Structure Predicts Trainability in Variational Quantum Models
title.zh: 线路结构可用于判断变分量子模型的可训练性

papers.authors: Wenbo Xie, Wojciech Szpankowski, Ananth Grama

summary.en: The authors derive a sufficient condition for gradients in a variational quantum circuit to retain at least inverse-polynomial variance under specified circuit and subspace assumptions. They also propose estimating gradient variance by sampling circuit runs. This offers a way to check for vanishing gradients before committing resources to training.
summary.zh: 作者在给定的线路和子空间条件下，推导出一个充分条件，使变分量子线路的梯度方差至少保持在逆多项式量级。论文还提出通过多次运行线路来采样估计梯度方差，从而在投入训练资源之前判断梯度是否会消失。
